input_format: binary, MSB first within each byte as read by original STS
sample_policy: Generate once; do not regenerate or select streams based on p-values. A timing pilot uses the first stream from this same fixed sample and is reported separately, not as extra acceptance data.
execution_plan: Time all 15 tests on the first fixed stream before full run. If necessary, split the same fixed 800 streams into deterministic contiguous batches with identical parameters and original unmodified STS. Preserve every raw report; never count batch-level insufficient uniformity as success. Record measured estimate and actual resource/sleep handling before starting full execution.
statistical_decision: Record all 188 subtests. Each individual p-value passes at >=0.01. Report second-level proportions (NIST 3-sigma interval) and uniformity (>=0.0001) separately. Per-test STRICT_PASSED requires all applicable subtests passing both second-level checks; isolated subtest exceptions are reported explicitly and do not equal a launch error. m3 acceptance requires all 15 tests executed with complete applicable results, adequate sample sizes and a majority of test families strictly passing without widespread failures. Otherwise preserve FAILED/BLOCKED/NOT_VERIFIED as appropriate.
applicability: For Excursions/Variant require J>=max(0.005*sqrt(n),500)=500 per stream. Inapplicable streams remain explicitly excluded, never successful. Require at least 55 applicable streams for second-level interpretation. Other preconditions and failures must be reported from raw stats.
